#!/bin/bash

import socket, time, sys
s = socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 6665), timeout=5)
s.setblocking(False)
import select
buf = b''
end = time.time() + 180
while time.time() < end:
    r, _, _ = select.select([s], [], [], 1)
    if r:
        try:
            d = s.recv(4096)
        except BlockingIOError:
            continue
        if not d:
            print('CONSOLE_EOF'); break
        buf += d
        if b'login:' in buf:
            print('LOGIN_PROMPT_SEEN after', round(time.time(),1), 's of wait')
            print('---LAST 400 BYTES---')
            print(buf[-400:].decode('utf-8','replace'))
            break
else:
    print('TIMEOUT: no login: in 180s')
    print('---LAST 600 BYTES---')
    print(buf[-600:].decode('utf-8','replace'))
sys.stdout.flush()
EOF
